services.p_text.20_language_support_for_: 20+ language support for international family and friends.
services.p_text.absolutely_many_couples_: Absolutely. Many couples start with one service (e.g. AI Video Generator) and add a Trailer or Meme Generator later once they see the first result. Each addition gets its own quote, timeline, and revision cycle.
services.p_text.bring_old_wedding_footag: Bring old wedding footage back to life with AI-powered restoration.
services.p_text.david_l_atlanta_slow_mot: “We wanted a keepsake beyond the standard highlight. WeddingAI slowed down our bouquet toss to 240fps and you can see every petal in mid-air. My mother-in-law cried watching the replay — she said it was the most beautiful three seconds of the whole day.”
services.p_text.from_restoring_30_year_o: From restoring 30-year-old tapes to creating cinematic AI films — explore all our wedding services by category.
services.p_text.ghibli_pixar_anime_water: Ghibli, Pixar, anime, watercolor — your wedding, animated.
services.p_text.hannah_t_sydney_family_m: “My grandmother is 94 and couldn’t fly to our wedding in Sydney. She recorded a 90-second message and WeddingAI played it on the big screen during the ceremony. When she saw herself in the video afterward, our whole family cried.”
services.p_text.hollywood_style_1_3_minu: Hollywood-style 1–3 minute trailer with licensed music.
services.p_text.if_you_re_unsure_submit_: If you're unsure, submit the form with 'Other / Not Sure' and a short description. Sofia will read your message, look at any sample footage you provide, and recommend the right service in her quote reply — no charge for the consultation.
services.p_text.include_your_furry_famil: Include your furry family members in the celebration.
services.p_text.integrate_video_messages: Integrate video messages from family who can't attend in person.
services.p_text.intro.svcsroot01: Browse 10+ AI-powered wedding video services — from cinematic trailers and multilingual dubbing to vintage restoration and family tributes.
services.p_text.jackson_w_portland_pet_w: “Our two rescue dogs have been ‘married’ twice before, so for our actual wedding we wanted them officiating. WeddingAI turned their photo-booth pics into a 30-second caption reel that played at the reception — it stole the show from the cake cutting.”
services.p_text.make_sure_no_one_is_miss: Make sure no one is missing from your wedding day.
services.p_text.make_your_wedding_video_: Make your wedding video uniquely yours with creative AI-powered options.
services.p_text.marcus_r_birmingham_al_v: “After my grandfather passed, I found his 1953 16mm wedding film in a shoebox. WeddingAI digitized it to 4K and color-corrected the faded footage. We played it at my grandmother’s 80th birthday — she saw her wedding day again for the first time in 60 years.”
services.p_text.not_sure_which_service_y: Not sure which service you need? Answer these 3 questions to narrow it down:
services.p_text.olivia_p_iceland_ai_vide: “We eloped in Iceland with just two witnesses. No professional video at all. WeddingAI took 200 photos from our photographer and turned them into a 3-minute cinematic film. People genuinely cannot believe we didn’t hire a videographer.”
services.p_text.respectfully_include_dec: Respectfully include deceased family members in your wedding video.
services.p_text.restore_30_year_old_vhs_: Restore 30-year-old VHS, 8mm, and Hi8 wedding footage to 4K.
services.p_text.shareable_clips_for_soci: Shareable clips for social media and group chats.
services.p_text.sophia_k_seattle_trailer: “Our videographer delivered a 12-minute recap but we wanted something punchier for Instagram. WeddingAI made a 90-second trailer in the style of a movie preview. It hit 50K views in a week and three couples in our feed hired them after seeing it.”
services.p_text.tell_us_about_your_day_a: Tell us about your footage and we'll recommend the right enhancement.
services.p_text.transform_standard_foota: Transform standard footage into smooth 60fps+ slow motion.
services.p_text.turn_your_photos_into_a_: Turn your photos into a cinematic wedding film using AI.
services.p_text.yes_and_we_encourage_it_: Yes, and we encourage it for fuller results. Most projects benefit from 2-3 services combined. We offer bundle discounts of 10-20% for 2+ services on the same project. Just mention which services in your request.
services.p_text.google_serp_for_types_of: Google SERPs for "types of wedding videos" (Nov 2025) surface Brides (5 styles), The Knot (10 styles), Blue Moon Video (7 styles), and WeddingWire (5 styles). Here's how WeddingAI.video's 12 styles compare — and why more styles matter for couples who don't fit the standard documentary / cinematic / traditional / storytelling / vintage mold.
